review_basis: Three separate subagent sessions reviewed the requested current manuscript bundle; this is not attested cross-model or blinded human peer review.

decision.current_defensible_thesis: TRACE-RPG implements a bounded, source-bound, auditable proposal-to-commit boundary for generated game-state transitions. It separates untrusted proposals, deterministic authorization, bounded repair, canonical mutation, and replay evidence.
current_evidence_supports: Source-bound historical protocol records and a bounded operator-assisted integration case
not_established: Candidate-model noninferiority to a fresh reference model
A machine-checked theorem or unconditional end-to-end safety guarantee
decision.impact_judgment: [INFERENCE] The methods-and-audit contribution is more defensible than an ontology-superiority contribution. Adding models alone does not establish novelty or identify ontology causality.

recommended_revision_order.change: State a single testable systems question and an explicit contribution/evidence ledger in Introduction. Distinguish source-bound observer, the E3 construction simulation, and an ontology-gate arm.
Give the ontology a concrete typed-state/action/rule example, then distinguish the representation, information available to repair, and authority to commit.

Group results by evidential role rather than module inventory: mechanism/negative controls, bounded integration evidence, and unexecuted empirical questions. Place every material limitation next to its table.
Compress related work into the actual gaps and move operational chronology to artifact references. Verify external novelty separately rather than infer it from model count.
Align the English/Korean title qualifications and source-bound claim scopes. Do not manufacture a bilingual defect from a truncated preview.
Keep proposed A/C experiments in protocol/future-work text until their own execution, analysis, replay, and independent review gates pass.

minimum_decisive_empirical_package.question: What does the deterministic boundary guarantee?
minimum_decisive_empirical_package.design: Use independent positive/negative expectations and explicit assumptions; test rejected proposals, bypass attempts, unchanged state on rejection, and replay. If a formal result is claimed, supply the proof and its exact domain.
minimum_decisive_empirical_package.limit: Finite tests alone are not a universal theorem.

minimum_decisive_empirical_package.question: Does the ontology add value beyond the same rules?
minimum_decisive_empirical_package.design: Hold facts, rule content, tools, information, and budgets fixed; include a strong plain-rule/programmatic baseline and a deterministic planner where applicable. Separate representation, repair, and gate interventions. Unsafe/no-gate observations must remain in an isolated non-production execution boundary.
minimum_decisive_empirical_package.limit: Two representations sharing the same ontology-derived workflow cannot identify ontology presence effects.

minimum_decisive_empirical_package.question: Can a different model be substituted in the same fixed game?
minimum_decisive_empirical_package.design: Pair candidates with a fresh reference on sealed independent assignments; preserve all assigned failures, exact requested/returned identity and unknown revisions, wall/call/repair budgets, goal completion, separate safety and replay, and measured-or-unknown latency/cost. Use the pilot to freeze a justified confirmatory sample and multiplicity-aware noninferiority analysis.
minimum_decisive_empirical_package.limit: A successful exploratory pilot or a non-significant difference is not a noninferiority result. Re-seeded object placement is not a held-out relation/motif.
